# What do you actually take home when you resell tickets?

> Find the list price that breaks even or hits your profit target after StubHub, SeatGeek, Vivid Seats or Ticketmaster seller fees, see whether a listing pays once you allow for the chance it does not sell, and audit your past sales by marketplace. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [How to price resale tickets so you do not lose money on the unsold ones](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ticket-resale-profit-calculator/ticket-resale-guide.html)
